items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: I took my own band up to Toronto with Dick Vance and Jimmy Crawford and Benny Morton

ctx.x: Oh, I knew Charlie Christian in Oklahoma City. And he used to come over and when we went there with Benny Morton he used to come and take guitar lessons from Eddie Durham. Charlie Christian and Blanton from Tennessee,
I played with his mother down in Chattanooga, Tennessee.
